chapter_title_en: The Bargaining Price of a Karmic Merit Disciple
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 373 – Evil Dragon River: Ji Ning’s Billion-Treasure Bid for a Disciple
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning offers a fortune to take a karmic-merit disciple, but the Qi prince lies. Then the Firewing Guards attack—and Ji Ning shows them what absolute power looks like.
og_title: Desolate Era – The Price of a Disciple
og_description: A hundred Heaven-ranked flying swords, a lie, and a squad of killers. Ji Ning’s quiet fury freezes a river.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 373: When the Firewing Guards Met Absolute Power
twitter_description: The Evil Dragon River froze. So did the Firewing Guards. Ji Ning didn’t even draw his sword.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary cursed river in the Star Continent; within 1,000 li, flight and Five Elements escape techniques are suppressed, making it a classic Xianxia 'forbidden zone.'

An elite demonic military squad wearing Dao-Soldier armor that allows them to link into a massive Firewing Insect formation; each squad contains a Primal-level great demon and eleven Wanxiang-level great demons.
A military technique where multiple armored cultivators fuse their power into a single beast-shaped phantom, drastically increasing their combat effectiveness.
A spiritually binding oath sworn to the Heavenly Dao itself; breaking it results in instant death. In Xianxia, it is the ultimate arbiter of truth.
A form of cosmic virtue earned by doing good deeds; a bearer of great karmic merit is considered extremely lucky for any clan and is often protected by fate.
